Explicit IID bootstrap.description: Explicit IID replacement percentile endpoints, not an automatic coverage guarantee; use a fresh stream if already seeded.

Seeded scientific randomness.description: Reproducible scientific PCG32 stream, not cryptographic randomness.

Everyday program.description: Start a program without GO_PARANOID or seal; outputs remain run-confined and hashed.

Paranoid program.description: Start a paranoid-mode program with one sealed value.

Assignment.description: Assign an expression to a name.

Print value.description: Print a named value using interpolation.

Formatted output.description: Print a numeric SI value with explicit precision.

Seal artifact.description: Preserve the current value as a run artifact.

For range loop.description: Half-open integer loop with a shared 1,000,000-iteration ceiling.

For each array value.description: Iterate an independent one-dimensional array value.

Continue loop.description: Start the nearest loop's next iteration.

While loop.description: Boolean-condition loop with a shared iteration ceiling.

If, else if, else.description: Boolean conditions; only the selected branch executes.

Switch cases.description: First exact matching case; no fallthrough.

G funk function.description: Define a local-scope function with an explicit return.

Parse a checked number.description: Convert finite, unitless decimal text to a quantity; invalid text fails.

Scientific square root.description: Real square root with checked domain and even unit exponents.

Scientific hypotenuse.description: Hypotenuse of two quantities with matching dimensions.

Astronomical units to metres.description: Convert an explicit number of astronomical units to SI metres.

Vector products.description: Dimension-checked homogeneous vector magnitude, dot, and cross products.

Spherical coordinates in degrees.description: Convert radius, inclination from +z, and azimuth from +x to [x, y, z].

Rotational motion.description: Explicit degree-based angular velocity, tangential speed, and centripetal acceleration.

Parse a checked integer.description: Convert decimal integer text within the exact f64 range; invalid text fails.

Split and join text.description: Split text into an array and join its text parts.

Ask for one line.description: Interactive text input; responses are preserved in the run evidence.

Program argument.description: Read a zero-based program argument after the -- separator.

Array and independent slice.description: Create an array and an independent half-open slice.

Append array item.description: Assign a new copy with one appended item.

FITS table mean.description: Read a numeric FITS binary-table column mean.

FITS selected statistics.description: Full-table half-open selection with optional positive weights. Result is [selected, used, weight sum, mean].

Explicit tolerance comparison.description: All four arguments required. Absolute tolerance matches operand dimensions; relative tolerance is dimensionless.

Exact floating-point bits.description: Compare finite f64 bits of matching dimensions, including the sign of zero; not evidence verification.

CSV result.description: Write a run-confined CSV result; GO_PARANOID is optional.
